newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan foreign minister to hold talks in Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Jordan foreign minister to hold talks in Egypt.

text.p: Jordan's Foreign Minister Fayez al-Tarawneh will hold talks in Cairo on Friday with Egyptian officials to coordinate efforts to revive the Middle East peace process, a government minister said.
"The visit to Cairo is in the framework of continued coordination with Egyptian officials," Information Minister Samir Mutawae told Reuters.
Jordan and Egypt, who have peace treaties with Israel, fear repercussions on regional stability of a continued logjam in peacemaking between Israel and the Palestinian Authority.
Talks have been suspended since March when Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu sent bulldozers to carve out a new Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem.
